overall_assessment: Reviewed all 34 entries: 28 fetched pages (19 suspects and nine controls) and six failed-fetch entries; substantive plans and facts are generally captured, with no demonstrated omission of on-page plan content, but recurring library-access boilerplate and concatenated headings/list items affect suspects and controls. The 17 sampled year flags come from spring-2026 reading-list labels on current-only pages and do not demonstrate wrong-year fetches under the stated pilot policy; PHD929 is a legitimately brief seminar plan, while TEOL8515 faithfully captures a metadata-only source shell with no uncaptured body, rather than showing extraction loss. All six failed URLs follow the observed MF slug pattern: the three 403 examples are forbidden responses without evidence of a URL defect, and the three 404 examples plausibly represent unavailable or discontinued pages (including legacy PKU502-07H); linked reading-list labels and packet truncation markers likewise do not prove missing on-page content.

findings.description: Local structure is lost even though whole-page wall flags are absent: random control TEOL5430 joins the knowledge/skills labels, student lead-ins and multiple outcomes without separators; random control TEOL8598 glues separate topics and teaching activities together; TEOL5116 joins the two subcourse headings without a space. These passages violate the requirement for separate headings, paragraphs and readable list items, and can obscure the boundaries between substantive outcomes or activities.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: MF rich-text fields are flattened through R/blocks.R (.sub_blocks(), .html_blocks()/walk_contents()) and R/extract_fulltext.R (.read_doc()). Inline runs are concatenated and squished, and HTML break handling can lose structural boundaries; some fields may already be concatenated in the source. The packet cannot distinguish those origins without inspecting the stored HTML.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect the stored HTML for these three fields, then preserve its explicit heading, list and br boundaries as separate blocks/newlines in R/blocks.R and .read_doc(), including breaks nested inside inline elements. For confirmed source-level concatenation, add an MF-specific post_fn in R/institution_config.R that separates exact known labels such as KUNNSKAPStudenten har: and FERDIGHETERStudenten kan:; avoid guessing boundaries in ordinary prose.

findings.description: A stock library-access block is visibly included in 20 of the 28 fetched texts, including five of the nine random controls. Its general instructions about Canvas, Oria, off-campus access and the National Library are site service boilerplate, rather than the course reading list or course-specific plan content. This recurring noise is not detected by the pre-pass junk phrases; the reading-list label itself should be retained.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The MF selector article .content-body includes the library help block. Its exclude configuration in R/institution_config.R removes contact cards, banners and facts-box buttons but has no exclusion or post_fn for this stock access text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an MF-specific post_fn that removes only the exact Tilgang til litteratur heading and its four standard access paragraphs, ending at via ditt lokale folkebibliotek. Preserve Litteraturliste, its course/semester link label and any actual references; do not remove arbitrary text following the reading-list heading.
